description: Governor's Secretariat of Southern Province - Dismissals, from the membership of the Director Board
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists the names of specific individuals (K. H. Kapila Senarathna, Piyasena Guruge, etc.) who are being dismissed from their positions on the boards of provincial authorities. It provides their names and the fact of their dismissal but contains no details about their portfolio responsibilities, duties, or the functions of the authorities they served on. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes like appointments, resignations, and dismissals without detailing their specific responsibilities.
